segments.oily: Reports are split: some oily-skin users say it caused breakouts and did not suit their oily face, while others (including acne-prone oily skin) say it removed makeup without clogging pores or adding shine.
segments.dry: One long-term user with mature/dry-leaning skin (bareminerals switcher) reports it is lighter than her previous oil and leaves skin hydrated rather than tight.
segments.combination: One combination-skin reviewer reports her skin feels soft and not oily after use.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are divided: some say the fragrance is too strong and irritating, while others report the scent does not bother their sensitive skin and find the product soothing.
segments.mature: One 50-year-old reviewer switching from a discontinued product reports this oil is lighter in texture and works well as a first make-up-removal step.
segments.normal: Reviewers who do not specify a particular concern generally describe soft, clean, hydrated skin after use.

concerns.aging: The one reviewer who identifies as older (mature skin) reports satisfaction, citing lightweight texture and effective make-up removal; no anti-aging effect is claimed.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report skin feels hydrated and not tight or stripped after cleansing; one dry/mature-leaning reviewer confirms no dryness compared with her previous oil.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports sensitivity and blemishes visibly calmed after nearly two weeks of use; no other redness-specific reports.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the product as gentle and non-stripping, with one explicitly noting it 'doesn't strip my skin.'
concerns.spots: One acne-prone reviewer reports a significant improvement using it as a second-cleanse step; another with acne-prone/sensitive skin says it does not prevent new breakouts and takes a while to clear existing acne; one reviewer reports the product gave her a lot of breakouts.
concerns.blemishes: Mixed: one reviewer reports reduced blemishes and sensitivity after two weeks, another reports no help with acne, and one reports new breakouts after use.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers with oily-prone skin report the oil does not leave the face feeling oily or greasy after rinsing, contrary to their expectation; one reviewer nonetheless reports it did not work for her oily face.

Its a good oil if you dint have ancr pron skin and only have sensitive skin. Its soothing and does leave your face feeling clean but takes a while yo get ride of any existing acne and doesnt do a goood job at preventing more ance from coming in. Not something i would personally use myself.

This is a good cleanser for the amount you receive and the price paid. I think it really works as intended to remove makeup, and I have no issues removing mascara! I expected it to be a bit thicker in consistency, it is very watery for an oil. I will say though, the scent to this is VERY strong. I'm not sure if it was intended to be that strong, but I do understand the reviews pointing out the scent. If you're sensitive to fragrance, I would avoid this product.

I have been using bareminerals cleansing oil in my daily routine for years on my now 50 year old face. I was so sad to see it discontinued but this product will definitely be my new go to cleansing oil. It has similar oils to bareminerals in the ingredients and is even lighter in texture which means a little goes a long way! Price is much better also. It cleans so well as my first step to remove makeup. So glad i found something i love even better!

I am a beginner in double cleansing. I had received a trail size and did a little research before using it. I know this says "helps to remove residue and makeup" and I am assuming everyone things it's a makeup remover, but that is not necessarily the case. You are meant to remove your makeup as normal and then on dried skin rub this oil cleanser to remove the excess residue that did not come off. I have felt a significant difference since the first time. After using the oil, my skin feels silky and one I follow up with my regular cleanser my skin feels so clean like it's never felt before. I did end up purchasing a full size after the trail size and will most likely continue unless I decide to try another brand. For reference I have very oily, acne-prone skin.

I was a little skeptical about this oil cleanser. Let me tell you that I loved it. My combination skin feels so soft not oily at all. It turns to a silky white when you remove with water. The smell is so fabulous. I really love this product!

I was surprised by the sent but it's grown on me because I love how soft it is and how it feels on my skin. Been using this for almost two weeks and a lot of my blemishes and sensitivity has gone down
